Field.name: OutputFile
Field.manpage: Output file for lengths. The output file may be omitted for output to terminal or log file.

Field.name: TiltFile
Field.manpage: File with tilt information in the format described above.

Field.name: ExtraLength
Field.usage: Fraction of a section to add to length of contour to account for section thickness
Field.manpage: Fraction of a section to add at the high Z end of each contour to account for section thickness. The default is 0.

Field.name: Magnification
Field.usage: Magnification of film, or 1 if CCD images
Field.manpage: Magnification of film images, or 1 if CCD images. This option is required if there is no scale in the model header.

Field.name: ScaleDigitized
Field.usage: Microns per pixel at which film was digitized, or pixel size in microns for CCD images
Field.manpage: Microns per pixel at which film was digitized, or pixel size in microns for CCD images. This option is required if there is no scale in the model header.

Field.name: SectionThickness
Field.manpage: Section thickness in nanometers. This option is required if there is no scale in the model header.

Field.name: ExcludeObjects
Field.usage: Objects to exclude from length measurement
Field.manpage: Objects to exclude from length measurement.

Field.name: MarkerObject
Field.usage: Object number of length marker for measuring overall spindle length
Field.manpage: Object number of length marker for measuring overall spindle length.

Field.name: CorrectObliques
Field.usage: Correct lengths of oblique MTs when sections are tilted
Field.manpage: Correct lengths of oblique MTs when sections are tilted.

Field.name: AxisAngle
Field.usage: Rotation angle from the vertical to the tilt axis
Field.manpage: Rotation angle from the vertical to the tilt axis in the raw images. This entry is required when correcting for obliqueness.

Field.name: AlignmentTransforms
Field.usage: File with transforms used to align the images
Field.manpage: File with transforms used to align the images. This entry is optional and is relevant only when correcting for obliqueness.

Field.name: InvertAngles
Field.usage: Change the sign of the tilt angles when adjusting lengths of oblique MTs
Field.manpage: Change the sign of the tilt angles when adjusting lengths of oblique fibers.

Field.name: UntiltTransforms
Field.usage: Output file for transforms that will correct model for tilted sections
Field.manpage: Output file for transforms that will correct model for tilted sections.

Field.name: ParameterFile
Field.manpage: Read parameter entries as keyword-value pairs from a parameter file.
